title: Is It Working? Metrics Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 35
description:
In Episode 1, Zoya made fifty laddoos and sold only eight. One year later, Laddoo Lab sells in local shops, a supermarket chain and online. But is the marketing really working? In this final animated lesson, the team builds Laddoo Lab's first yearly scorecard.

You will see what marketing performance metrics are and the three parts of a good metric (a number, a goal and a time). Then we build the scorecard live with example figures: sales growth of 30%, customer retention of 85%, a cost to win each customer of Rs 500 (over its goal), and a 150% return on the festive campaign. We meet Fred Reichheld's Net Promoter Score (2003) and work out Laddoo Lab's score of +50, see these metrics at work in a phone maker, a bank, a food delivery app and an airline, and look at the human side honestly: some numbers look good but mean little, and as Marilyn Strathern put it in 1997, when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.

This is Episode 35, the final episode of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students. All 35 episodes are in the Marketing Management playlist.
